title: The Petrified Garden
physical_identity: A planetoid-sized tree superorganism with dark dense surface forest, tunnel-cavern glow rooms lit by Sorries, ancient ruins, and a hollow core with Green Giants and a water heart.
scale_topology: Planetoid, surface area about Ceres; indoor-like caverns and tunnels, surface forest, hollow core; Green Giants up to 3.2 km.
lighting_sound: Surface dim and dense; glow rooms bioluminescent multicolour, damp cool; Sorries whisper 'sorry...'; sentries scream like rusty chainsaws.

entities.name: Gardener's Sorries
entities.behavior: Bioluminescent glowworm-like light sources that whisper 'sorry...'.

entities.name: Volpes, Hounds, Clumps, Smilers, Death Rats, Deathmoths (male and female), Curabitur Birds
entities.behavior: Present, mostly underground; behaviours not described here.

entities.name: Buried sentries
entities.behavior: Trapped in wood and bark; scream when awakened by a phrase.

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Gardener's Sorries, Volpes, Hounds, Clumps, Smilers, Death Rats, Deathmoths, Curabitur Birds, Wranglers, buried sentries
items_communities: M.E.G. Base Seedling (Almond Water squirt guns, steady water, limited food)
